data.body: Implementation milestone: separate held-out implementer completed in two attempts. Full held-out GREEN 7 cases in 4.01s; exact-defect mutation of the small payload back to 141 MiB failed at 144432 KiB against the 1024 KiB oracle and restoration returned GREEN. Final CI-shaped file 10 passed: pytest wall 78.85s to 24.06s, process real 113.08s to 24.28s, setup about 99.99s to 14.78s, aggregate CPU 145.27s to 27.90s. Maintained OSS and prior constraints are recorded on the ticket. Local preflight green: make lint, make typecheck, make test with 13518 passed and 60 skipped, plus the integration file. Refactoring litmus passes because tests assert only packet behavior, object presence/absence, pack size, persisted convergence, and push results; internal helper extraction/renaming is not observed.
